semanticTheme.zhHans: 「外在视觉」在 source 中描述注意力较容易通过外观、排列与可见线索捕捉信息。R3 把它作为感知通道，而不是把这种感受升级成真相判断。

semanticTheme.zhHans: 「洞穴｜混合」在 source 中描述一种环境关注模式：可控、有边界的空间，同时对进入者与信息保留一定开放度。R3 把它当作环境适配的实验变量，不把地点写成命定居住地。
semanticTheme.en: In the source, “Caves | blended” describes an environmental attention pattern: bounded, controllable spaces with some openness to people and information. R3 treats it as an experiment in environmental fit, not as a destined place to live.

experientialExpression.zhHans: 重点是比较可控、有边界的空间，同时对进入者与信息保留一定开放度时，你的专注、互动与恢复感是否更容易，而不是要求搬家、换工作或永久避开另一类环境。
experientialExpression.en: The practical question is whether bounded, controllable spaces with some openness to people and information makes attention, interaction, or recovery feel more workable, rather than requiring relocation, a job change, or permanent avoidance of another setting.

experimentInvitation.zhHans: 优先做低成本的场景比较：座位位置、开放度、参与程度、活动密度或自然／人造边界等；记录实际体验，再决定这个变量是否有用。

realityObservation.en: Reality verification asks whether bounded, controllable spaces with some openness to people and information repeatedly changes how you work or interact across settings, while retaining contexts that do not fit.

customerBoundary.zhHans: Environment 是 ADVANCED MODIFIER，不是房地产、职业、健康或财富结果预测。它不能要求搬迁，也不能覆盖已确认的 Type、Authority、Profile、Definition、Channels 或 Centers。

experimentInvitation.zhHans: 把 Trajectory 当作回顾性观察：比较过去、现在与不同环境中的角色位置，记录哪些变化真正发生、哪些只是 source 语言没有现实对应。
experimentInvitation.en: Use Trajectory retrospectively: compare role position across past, present, and different environments, recording what genuinely changed and what has no real-world correspondence.

coreStructureInteraction.zhHans: 这层只在 Type、Authority、Profile、Definition、Channels、Centers 与必要的 Gate evidence 之后修饰读取；若与核心结构冲突，以核心结构与现实证据为先。
coreStructureInteraction.en: This layer modifies the reading only after Type, Authority, Profile, Definition, Channels, Centers, and necessary Gate evidence. If it conflicts with core structure, core structure and real-world evidence take precedence.

realityObservation.zhHans: 现实验证关注「通过观察与保持距离累积可用视角」是否在长期、跨情境重复出现；若没有，应保留 NOT_OBSERVED 或 CONTEXT_DEPENDENT，而不是强行解释。

customerMeaning.zhHans: 较有用的方式是观察多年经验中，是否逐渐出现「逐渐让自己的实际做法成为别人可以观察的示例」的变化，而不是根据一次事件宣告你已经“成为”某个角色。
customerMeaning.en: A useful reading observes whether allowing one’s lived practice to become an example that others can observe becomes visible across years of experience rather than declaring from one event that you have “become” a role.

customerMeaning.zhHans: 把 Trajectory 当作回顾性观察：比较过去、现在与不同环境中的角色位置，记录哪些变化真正发生、哪些只是 source 语言没有现实对应。
customerMeaning.en: Use Trajectory retrospectively: compare role position across past, present, and different environments, recording what genuinely changed and what has no real-world correspondence.

customerMeaning.en: Reality verification asks whether allowing one’s lived practice to become an example that others can observe recurs over time and across contexts. If not, retain NOT_OBSERVED or CONTEXT_DEPENDENT rather than forcing the interpretation.
